A memo whose compute reads itself is an application-author mistake, so the panic is reachable from app input and is undocumented on the public `Memo::get`/`with`/`get_untracked`/`with_untracked`. Add a `# Panics` section to those methods documenting the cycle panic, and add a fallible form that returns an error, e.g. `pub fn try_get(&self) -> Result<T, MemoCycleError>` with `pub struct MemoCycleError;` (or make recompute return Result and thread it through ensure_fresh). Repo policy requires the documented panic to be paired with a try_* form.
